notes: Routing model: the skill is **preloaded on the `code-reviewer` sub-agent**; generic 'review this PR' intents route to the agent (which loads the skill's content via preload), not directly to the skill. The skill fires as a top-level Skill tool call only when the caller invokes it explicitly (mentions the methodology, the 10-category walk, Conventional Comments severity, Google/Wiegers/OWASP style, or asks for a no-agent direct walkthrough). Positives below are skill-explicit invocations. Generic PR-review prompts that should route to the code-reviewer agent are marked negative here.
